mechanism_narrative: The persistently low federal funds rate (0.1%) compresses discount rates for equity valuation, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days. This signal is always active as the federal funds rate is continuously observed.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of the time when FEDFUNDS < 0.5%.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in CPI (CPIAUCSL > 2.5% year-over-year) signals inflationary pressure that triggers central bank tightening, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of the time when CPIAUCSL > 2.5%.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate rises by more than 0.2% in 3 months AND CPIAUCSL rises by more than 0.3% in 3 months, it indicates a tightening monetary cycle that reduces equity valuations, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: FEDFUNDS rises > 0.2% in 3 months AND CPIAUCSL rises > 0.3% in 3 months
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of the time when both FEDFUNDS rises > 0.2% in 3 months and CPIAUCSL rises > 0.3% in 3 months.

mechanism_narrative: In high unemployment regimes (UNRATE > 5.5% for 3 months), the Federal Reserve maintains accommodative monetary policy, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of the time when UNRATE > 5.5% for 3 months.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in industrial production (INDPRO < 95 for 3 months) signals an economic slowdown, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of the time when INDPRO < 95 for 3 months.

mechanism_narrative: High residential sales (RSAFS > 610000 million) indicate strong consumer demand, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of the time when RSAFS > 610000.

mechanism_narrative: Strong labor market growth (PAYEMS > 146000 thousand) signals robust economic activity, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of the time when PAYEMS > 146000.

mechanism_narrative: In high housing demand regimes (HOUST > 1650.0 thousand), strong economic growth drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of the time when HOUST > 1650.0.
